name: rootagentv2
description: Local safety supervisor: constitution, allowlisted agents, thought pipelines, harmonic memory.

scripts.compile: npm run build:bundle && pkg dist/rootagentv2-bundle.cjs --config package.json --out-path dist/executables
scripts.compile:linux: npm run build:bundle && pkg dist/rootagentv2-bundle.cjs --target node20-linux-x64 --output dist/executables/rootagentv2-linux
scripts.compile:macos: npm run build:bundle && pkg dist/rootagentv2-bundle.cjs --target node20-macos-x64 --output dist/executables/rootagentv2-macos
